liquidbounce.module.uuidQuest.descriptio: Submits the premium (v4) player UUIDs you see to uuid.quest.
liquidbounce.module.uuidQuest.value.tabL: Collect UUIDs from the tab list.
liquidbounce.module.uuidQuest.value.worl: Collect UUIDs from players in the world.
liquidbounce.module.uuidQuest.value.note: Optional label sent with each submission (up to 200 characters).
liquidbounce.module.uuidQuest.value.anno: Where to announce UUIDs that were new to uuid.quest. Shown once you are in a world.
liquidbounce.module.uuidQuest.value.verb: Show the outcome of every submission in chat.
